0022600144.text: The Cavaliers (3-1) come in on a three-game winning streak, sitting 2nd in the Central, 0.5 games back, and 5th in the East, with a 3-0 home record and a 0-1 road mark. The Atlanta Hawks (2-3) are 7th in the East and 2nd in the Southeast, 1 game back, and are on a three-game losing streak after going 0-2 at home. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the most recent meeting on April 10, 2026, in Atlanta, where the Hawks won 124-102. Meleek Thomas is out for Cleveland with a foot injury, while Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture).
